original.target_description: Two candidate repeated-measures ANOVA interactions of Current Probe Location and Previous Probe Location on median RT: Colour task and Threat task; supplied locator does not distinguish them.

notes: Identity verified from supplied text: author's accepted manuscript of Acta Psychologica; title Trial-to-trial Carryover Effects on Spatial Attentional Bias; authors Thomas E. Gladwin and Bernd Figner; published DOI 10.1016/j.actpsy.2019.04.006. This is a full primary manuscript, including Methods, Results, Discussion and references, not an abstract-only parse. No PDF supplied. The published-page locator p. 54 cannot distinguish the two task variants in the manuscript. The neutral description describes both Current Probe Location by Previous Probe Location interactions and does not identify cue category. The replication reference title is not a unique original-test locator. Candidate Colour interaction: F(1, 143) = 91, p < .0001, partial eta squared = 0.39 (manuscript p. 8, lines 181–183). Candidate Threat interaction: F(1, 143) = 8.5, p = .0042, partial eta squared = 0.056 (p. 9, lines 192–193). Preserve same-test pairings; neither candidate is assigned. Common candidate analytic participant N = 144 is explicitly printed in Participants, p. 6, lines 119–121, after removing participants with overall accuracy below .8 or incomplete data; recruitment N = 163. No N derivation from df or sum was performed. Both tasks were completed by participants (p. 8, lines 161–162). Trial exclusions: first four task trials, first trial of each block, incorrect responses and following trials, RT above 3000 ms, duplicate logs, repeated/restarted task performance (p. 8, lines 165–170). Per field-scope rule, common model N remains a candidate in dispositions while target correspondence is unresolved. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders; no replication source inspected.
